input.summary: Dry Goods shelf at Yaba Market Store is fully compliant: all 5 planogram SKUs (Indomie Chicken 70g, Indomie Onion Chicken 120g, Golden Penny Spaghetti 500g, Dangote Spaghetti 500g, Golden Penny Semovita 1kg) observed at their expected facings, 0 stock-outs, 100% planogram share, no unknown products. No reorders proposed and no inventory lookup needed, since nothing is out or below minimum. The actionable issue is equipment: telemetry shows the store fridge above 8°C for 40 minutes with an 11.2°C peak, consistent with the auditor's "fault" note. A high-urgency technician dispatch was proposed (est. ₦15,000) and the manager was notified by WhatsApp to relocate chilled stock immediately and check for spoilage before resale.
